# `tensors.aug`

<a id="symbol-calculate"></a>
## `calculate` · [source](tensors.aug#L5)

Add two CPU tensors using LibTorch and return the sum of their elements. Failures can raise [`TensorError`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-pytorch/0.1.1/contracts.aug.md#symbol-TensorError).

It sets `left` of type [`Tensor`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-pytorch/0.1.1/bindings.aug.md#symbol-Tensor) to [`tensor`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-pytorch/0.1.1/api.aug.md#symbol-tensor) with `values` from a list containing `1.0`, `2.0`, `3.0`. `left` of type [`Tensor`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-pytorch/0.1.1/bindings.aug.md#symbol-Tensor) owns this value. It sets `right` of type [`Tensor`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-pytorch/0.1.1/bindings.aug.md#symbol-Tensor) to [`tensor`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-pytorch/0.1.1/api.aug.md#symbol-tensor) with `values` from a list containing `4.0`, `5.0`, `6.0`. `right` of type [`Tensor`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-pytorch/0.1.1/bindings.aug.md#symbol-Tensor) owns this value.

It sets `result` of type [`Tensor`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-pytorch/0.1.1/bindings.aug.md#symbol-Tensor) to [`add`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-pytorch/0.1.1/api.aug.md#symbol-add) with `left` and `right`. `result` of type [`Tensor`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-pytorch/0.1.1/bindings.aug.md#symbol-Tensor) owns this value. It returns [`sum`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-pytorch/0.1.1/api.aug.md#symbol-sum) with `tensor` from `result`.
